pack.name: font-malformed-fixtures
pack.summary: Malformed and fuzzed fonts from the OpenType Sanitiser's own corpus — the material a browser font validator exists to reject, undeclared provenance, build input only.

license.covers: khaledhosny/ots is BSD-3-Clause, which covers the sanitiser source. These fonts sit in tests/fonts/ under content-hash filenames with no per-file licence, no manifest and no provenance note; OTS declares nothing about them and neither do we.
As above: the repository's BSD-3-Clause covers the sanitiser, not the fuzzer corpus in tests/fonts/, which carries no declaration.
